purpose: Behavioral scenarios for adaptive discovery and reference-driven section composition.

cases.prompt: 첨부한 사전을 실제로 참고해서 제품 작동 설명 섹션의 구현 지시서를 써줘. 막연히 스크롤 효과라고 하지 말고 원문 패턴과 배치·트리거·모바일 대안을 연결해줘. 문서만 작성해.
cases.reply: 설명은 순서가 있는 세 단계이고 각 단계에 제공한 제품 이미지가 있어. 기존 헤더 높이와 spacing 토큰을 재사용해. 모션 상세는 맡길게.
cases.expected: Read the supplied relevant layout entries, name the selected source pattern and distinguish source guidance from authored measurements. Choose a definite layout, define active-step selection and reverse/rapid-scroll behavior, content-preserving mobile and reduced-motion alternatives, image failure handling and observable checks. Deliver instructions without product writes or claiming rendered evidence.
cases.failure: Only name sticky-scroll-reveal, describe effects as smooth/responsive without decisions, claim generated durations came from the dictionary, hide information when motion is disabled, or claim source access without reading the supplied file.
cases.evidence: Source-read trace, source-to-decision mapping and a concrete instruction artifact; separately list author-chosen values and unperformed checks.

setup.workspace: isolated document-only evaluation
facts: Evaluator supplies the actual Vibe Dictionary layout-taxonomy.md entries sticky-scroll-reveal and sticky-stacking-cards, three ordered step descriptions and three permitted product images.
If the git-ignored local snapshot references/dictionary/ exists, reading it counts as an original-source read: the agent records snapshot: 2026-09-11 and does not call it a live-site observation.
Repeat without source files: the agent may use packaged dictionary-recipes.md but must identify it as a packaged summary, not a fresh original-source read.
artifacts: steps.json and three images: evaluator-supplied approved content

cases.prompt: 자료실 화면을 섹션별로 어떻게 구현할지 지시서만 작성해줘. 코드는 바꾸지 마. 제목과 소개, 검색/태그 필터, 자료 목록이 필요해. 화면 상세는 맡길게.
cases.reply: 제공한 글 두 건의 제목·요약을 Enter 또는 검색 버튼으로 검색하고 태그는 하나만 선택해. 이미지 없음. 기술 스택과 파일 구조는 미정이야.
cases.expected: Deliver a section map and concrete instructions for hierarchy, layout and responsive transitions, typography, search/filter state ownership and triggers, no-results recovery, keyboard behavior and observable checks. Use content-led rows without invented covers. Keep implementation targets stack-neutral and explicitly unconfirmed. Do not edit code or claim rendered evidence.
cases.failure: Only list hero/bento/modern labels, invent existing component paths or a framework requirement, add stock covers, ask for delegated per-section choices, or mutate files despite document-only scope.
cases.evidence: Actual instruction artifact, named sections with actionable decisions, explicit unverified implementation status, and tool log showing no product writes.

Shared tokens: content max 72rem; gaps 8/16/24/48px; narrow breakpoint 48rem.

cases.reply: 현재 헤더와 토큰을 유지해. 로컬 자료만 필터링하고 상세 링크는 그대로 사용해. 디자인 선택은 맡기며 패키지 설치는 하지 마.

Reuse existing tokens and link data; verify keyboard submit, tag selection, clear/reset, zero results and narrow/wide rendering. Report unavailable checks explicitly.
cases.failure: Stop after a section plan despite an implementation request, invent APIs, install dependencies, redesign the preserved header, or claim browser verification without evidence.
cases.evidence: Section-to-file mapping, actual diff, functional state checks and real viewport evidence or explicit validation gaps.
